cases.rationale: Both cohorts provide exact D3163 apparent-shear observations with distinct specimens and independent manufacturing clusters.
Unaged and aged D3163 observations exist for both configurations, linked through matched cluster sets and a common aging exposure.
The D5573 observations and taxonomy are well-formed, but the repository has not yet qualified a cluster-aware proportion-equivalence analysis method.
The evidence graph is structurally valid, but the analysis interval crosses the frozen equivalence margin.
Retention requires separately measured unaged strength references for both configurations.
Aged observations must be bound to a qualified exposure protocol and receipt.
The same raw artifact cannot serve as both unaged and aged strength.
Aged and unaged cohorts for the same configuration must cover the same independent manufacturing clusters.
Baseline and candidate aging exposures must use the same qualified conditions and protocol.
A failure-mode fraction is descriptive and cannot establish failure acceptability.
Failure-mode proportions require a frozen, versioned classification taxonomy.
Unregistered or opaque bond-quality aggregation is not an admissible endpoint transform.
Wettability cannot replace joint-strength observations.
Observation receipt identity is unique across source nodes.
Analysis result must bind the exact set of source observation receipt IDs.
The transform cannot be changed after outcome availability without a new preregistered generation.
Two independent clusters are below the frozen minimum of three, regardless of coupon count.
The proportion-analysis profile must be registered by the statistics owner.
The full equivalence-design receipt has no receipt digest; its derived endpoint must remain blocked even though the other plan fields are present.
Baseline and candidate samples cannot reuse the same physical specimen identity.
Every aged/unaged method observation must have a distinct immutable receipt identity.
A continuous ASTM D1151 receipt cannot be described as a cyclic D1183 exposure.
The conditioning method receipt must bind the exact exposure protocol digest.
FRP-to-FRP direct strength is supported by matching D5868-01R23 joint-strength observation receipts.
D5573 generalization beyond its registered SMC FRP scope remains blocked.
D5656 constitutive response cannot replace direct joint-level apparent-shear strength evidence.
Ten coupons per arm are drawn from one lot each; coupon count does not satisfy the preregistered minimum of three independent material lots.
